implementation_constraints: reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0

unresolved_intent.decision: treat any key outside {id,priority,arrival,duration,deadline} as malformed input (whole input -> ERROR)
unresolved_intent.rationale: the spec says a job is an object 'with exactly the fields' id/priority/arrival/duration and optionally deadline; 'exactly' reads as a closed field set, not merely 'at least these'

unresolved_intent.decision: accept any integer deadline, including values less than arrival or negative, with no extra range check
unresolved_intent.rationale: the spec constrains only arrival and duration to be non-negative; it never states a bound on deadline, so a job can legitimately miss on its very own arrival tick if deadline <= arrival

unresolved_intent.ir_region: selection tie-break scope ('including the one that was running last tick')
unresolved_intent.decision: treat this clause as descriptive, not as an instruction to force-include an already-resolved job in the ready set — a still-ready previously-running job is already present in the ready set by construction
unresolved_intent.rationale: only completed/missed jobs are ever removed from ready, so the previously-running job is automatically a selection candidate whenever it hasn't finished; no separate re-insertion logic is needed

unresolved_intent.decision: implement completion as remaining <= 0 after decrementing (so remaining starts at 0, decrements to -1, and is treated as complete) rather than special-casing zero-duration jobs before the decrement
unresolved_intent.rationale: keeps one uniform execution rule for all jobs while still satisfying 'a job with duration 0 emits start and complete at the same tick'

unresolved_intent.decision: loop strictly while any job id remains unresolved (not completed, not missed); idle is emitted only when the ready set is empty on such a tick, which by construction always means at least one job has yet to arrive
unresolved_intent.rationale: matches the spec's termination rule ('ends after the last job completes or is missed... no idle once no job is ready and none is left to arrive') without needing a separate lookahead check
